intro: One shared GenAI platform with six layers and a column of trust services; four blueprints cover most enterprise demand. Agents gather evidence and act within policy; humans make member-impacting decisions.

layers.name: Channels
layers.detail: Amazon Connect voice, chat and tasks; member web and app; agent desktop; employee Teams or Slack; batch jobs.

layers.name: Edge and identity
layers.detail: WAF, API Gateway, enterprise IdP federation, member verification, on-behalf-of tokens passed to every tool.

layers.name: Routing and AI gateway
layers.detail: Small intent classifier first, LLM fallback for ambiguous requests; per-LOB keys, budgets, rate limits, PHI-aware model routing.

layers.name: Agent runtime
layers.detail: Coordinator plus domain sub-agents (Strands or LangGraph) on AgentCore Runtime; harness with hooks, loop and token limits, checkpoints, approval gates.

layers.name: Tools and knowledge
layers.detail: MCP gateway to claims, eligibility, CRM, case and scheduling APIs; Managed Knowledge Base or hybrid RAG with citations.

layers.name: Models
layers.detail: Bedrock frontier model to reason, small model for routine steps, fine-tuned classifiers; BAA-covered models only for PHI.

blueprints.name: Agentic contact-center self-service
blueprints.point: Known intents stay deterministic; only open-ended requests reach the AI agent.
flow: Deterministic Lex path OR AI agent with MCP tools
Close and log OR warm transfer with summary
notes: Pass summary, intent and auth status to the human agent

blueprints.name: Enterprise knowledge RAG
blueprints.point: Answers come only from retrieved, permitted, cited content.
flow: Chunk by structure, tag plan, state, version, ACL
Rewrite query and filter by caller's permissions
Hybrid retrieve (BM25 + vector, RRF) and rerank
Grounding check; if it fails, say unknown and offer a human
notes: Pilot on Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base first
Metadata and effective dates are half the retrieval

blueprints.name: Multi-agent back-office workflow
blueprints.point: Agents assemble the evidence; a licensed human makes the decision.
flow: Document, policy and history agents in parallel
Clinical reviewer decides; approved write-back via tool; audit ledger
notes: Durable orchestration, not a chat loop
Write tool callable only with a signed reviewer decision

blueprints.name: Long-running proactive employee agent
blueprints.point: The agent wakes on schedules and events, then asks before it acts.
flow: Agent worker on AgentCore Runtime with checkpoints
Memory and MCP tools (Connect metrics, WFM, ticketing)

checklist: Problem, success metric and agency level written down
Decisions the agent may never make are listed
End-user identity passed on-behalf-of to every tool
Every tool is an MCP tool with a contract, owner and allowlist entry
Only BAA-covered models see PHI; egress blocked by default
Input, output and tool-call guardrails on, with healthcare PII recognizers
Loop, step, token and dollar limits per session
SME-labelled golden set; trace-level evals pass thresholds
Full traces with model, prompt version, sources and tool calls
Fallback for every dependency and a warm handoff to a human
Runbook, on-call owner and kill switch
